title: Bayoglu 2017a: pcsa of transversus abdominis at whole (M, cadaver)

imaging.modality: dissection + laser diffraction + optical tracking of attachments

quantity.name: pcsa
quantity.definition: physiological CSA = muscle volume (mass/density) / fibre length (x cos pennation if stated)

source.authors: Bayoglu R, Geeraedts L, Groenen KHJ, Verdonschot N, Koopman B, Homminga J
source.sample: 1 embalmed cadaver; one embalmed male cadaver, 79 y, 154 cm, 51 kg (Alzheimer; L5 fused to sacrum); one body side; same cadaver for lumbar (2017a) and thoracic/cervical (2017b) datasets

how_to_simulate: Sum the PCSA (or F_max / specific tension) of all model elements of transversus abdominis, one side (or the named fascicle).
Compare with the cadaveric mean +/- SD; note specific tension and fibre-length normalisation used by the source.
protocol.notes: Per-element TrA rows are on a page whose text layer is not parseable.
